shortDescription: AIIMS NORCET 11th Nursing Officer Online Form 2026 – apply 24 July to 13 August 2026 at aiimsexams.ac.in. ~2218 Nursing Officer vacancies.
content:
AIIMS, New Delhi has started online registration for NORCET-11 (Nursing Officer Recruitment Common Eligibility Test).

Eligible candidates can apply from 24 July 2026 to 13 August 2026 (5:00 PM) for Nursing Officer posts (Level-7) across AIIMS and participating institutes. Tentative vacancies: ~2218.

Selection is through Stage-I and Stage-II computer-based tests. Apply only on aiimsexams.ac.in.
